title: The timings test requires 'Right now members see' before anything is saved
what: The one screen test for gym timings picks a ready-made week and, before Save is ever tapped, requires the top line to read 'Right now members see: Open now'. Members see nothing yet at that moment. So the test locks in the wrong line already reported, and a fix would turn the test red.
expected: Before the first save the line says what members will see once saved, and the test checks those words instead.
fix_line: Change the test to expect the not-saved-yet wording together with the screen fix

title: The skipped-rows download copies Aadhaar numbers as they were, and no test notices
what: When an import file has an Aadhaar or PAN column, the screen says ID numbers are never imported. But the 'Download skipped rows' file writes every skipped row back out cell by cell, exactly as it was in the file, ID column included. The file check only looks at the reason column. A gym that downloads the skipped rows gets a fresh file of members' Aadhaar numbers.
expected: The skipped-rows file leaves out or blanks any column found to hold ID numbers, and ID numbers inside other cells, and a test checks that.
how_often: every import with an ID column and a skipped row
fix_line: Blank the ID columns in the skipped-rows file and add a test for it

title: Gym timings for a gym with two branches are never tested
what: No test opens Gym timings in a gym with two branches. Nothing checks the 'Each branch has its own timings' line, that each branch keeps its own week, or that members of one branch never see the other branch's hours. The server test only tries a second, unrelated gym.
expected: A test saves different timings in two branches and checks each branch, and each branch's members, see their own.
fix_line: Add a two-branch case to the timings tests

title: Most of the member page is never checked by a test
what: Tests touch the member page only for the Dues tile, the plan dates and a few empty lines. Nothing checks 'Member since', the status pill, the Training pattern card, the Details card fields, editing a field and seeing it kept after a refresh, the 'Check this member' note for a shared mobile with its 'Checked' button, or the 'Member not found' page for a bad link.
expected: Tests open a full member page and check each card, edit one field and refresh, open a bad member link, and clear a possible-double note.
fix_line: Add a member page test that reads every card and the not-found page

title: The member page is never checked as the front desk, apart from the money buttons
what: Only one test opens a member page signed in as the front desk, and it only checks that the cancel and extra-days buttons are gone. No front-desk test reads the tiles and cards, a pass member's page, a new member's empty page, checks a member in from the page, opens the member card or shares the app link.
expected: A front-desk test opens a member with a plan, a pass member and a new member, checks them in, opens the card and shares the link.
fix_line: Add a front-desk run through the member page

title: Checking in from the member page: the toast, a failure and the next day are never tested
what: Tests see 'Checked in today' on the member page, but never the 'Saving…' state, the 'Checked in for today.' toast, the red banner when the save fails with the button coming back, a member already checked in by the poster, or the button turning back to 'Check in' the next day.
expected: A test taps Check in on the member page, reads the toast, makes one save fail, and moves the clock to the next day.
fix_line: Add these steps to a member page check-in test

title: Archiving offline, a failed archive and reminders after archiving are never tested
what: No test archives a member without internet, makes an archive fail, or checks that expiry and dues reminders stop going to an archived member. Restoring is already listed as untested elsewhere.
expected: Tests archive offline and on a failing server and see the pill and button not change, and check that an archived member drops off the reminder lists.
fix_line: Add offline, failure and reminder checks to the archive test

title: Import progress words and a second tap on Add are never tested
what: No test checks 'Reading the file…', 'Adding members…', the '<done> of <total> done. Keep this page open' line, that the back button hides while it runs, the 'rows are not saved yet' line after a stop, or that a second tap on Add starts nothing.
expected: The import test reads the progress lines during a slow save and taps Add twice.
fix_line: Add progress and double-tap checks to the import test

title: AI column matching: the waiting line, a late answer and the owner's own pick are never tested
what: Tests check the AI's finished line, but never 'Matching your columns with AI…', the '· Matched by AI' tag on a box, a box the owner set while the AI was still working, an answer that arrives after the owner moved to a new header row or another sheet, or the tag leaving a box the owner changed.
expected: Tests hold the AI answer back, change a box and the sheet meanwhile, then let it arrive and check the owner's choices stand.
how_often: every import with odd column names
fix_line: Add a slow-AI case to the AI import test

title: Importing a file with several sheets is never tested on screen
what: No test picks a sheet from a workbook, checks the sheet list with row counts, the '· added' mark, or the 'Import the next sheet' button after the first sheet is done.
expected: A test imports a three-sheet file, adds the first sheet, then the next from the finished card.
fix_line: Add a three-sheet workbook to the import tests
